summary: Iteration 2 testing: P0 Decimal precision, Backtest engine, Settings/Webhook alerts, and Jupiter swap. Backend: 14/14 new pytest tests passed (decimal precision for 1.5e-7 priced coins, multi-buy cost basis, bots P&L fields, 4 backtest strategies, settings CRUD, webhook test/dispatch, Jupiter quote+build live against lite-api.jup.ag). Existing 29/29 pytest tests still pass = 43/43 total. Frontend: 3 test-blocking missing-import bugs found and fixed (Settings not imported in App.js, Webhook[s] icon doesn't exist in @phosphor-icons/react -> swapped to Bell, LiveSwap not imported in CoinDetail.jsx). After fixes, full UI flow verified: register -> dashboard -> /settings (renders, save+test-webhook works, persistence verified after reload), /bots (BACKTEST button opens panel, backtest runs and renders equity-curve chart), /coins/bonk (PAPER/LIVE toggle wired; LIVE shows liveswap-connect-phantom button for solana coins; PAPER shows execute-trade-btn).
action_items: Already-fixed-by-testing-agent (please review): App.js missing `import Settings from "@/pages/Settings"`, Settings.jsx imported non-existent `Webhooks` icon (renamed to `Bell`), CoinDetail.jsx referenced `LiveSwap` without importing it. All three were ReferenceErrors that crashed the page on first render. Consider adding an ESLint pre-commit (no-undef) to catch these earlier.
critical_code_review_comments: Three ReferenceError import omissions shipped to preview (Settings, LiveSwap, Webhooks icon). Would have been caught by `eslint --rule no-undef:error` or a TS migration. Recommend adding lint to CI.
server.py is now ~950 lines — past the 700-line guideline. Still readable but consider splitting (auth, coins, trades, bots, ai, swap, settings, backtest) into a routers/ package.
_execute_trade now correctly uses Decimal for amount_coin / cost_basis math; verified with $50 @ 1.5e-7 -> ~3.33e8 coins (precision better than 1e-6 relative).
/api/settings/test-webhook returns 200 with {ok:false} on non-2xx but raises only on missing url. Acceptable.
Jupiter endpoints proxy lite-api.jup.ag with no auth and 12-15s timeout — fine, but consider caching the quote briefly on backend if UI polls.
dispatch_webhook is fire-and-forget via asyncio.create_task — good, but errors are only logged; consider per-user dead-letter counter for observability.
Settings.jsx loads webhook_url via useEffect after mount — there is a brief race where reload + immediate read returns empty. Tests now poll, but consider showing a loading state.

rca_of_the_issue: Three ReferenceError defects on first deploy because the new files were authored with usages but matching imports were forgotten. (1) /app/frontend/src/App.js used <Settings /> route element but `import Settings from '@/pages/Settings'` was missing. Mitigation: added import. (2) /app/frontend/src/pages/Settings.jsx imported `Webhooks` from `@phosphor-icons/react` but the package exports `Bell`/etc. — there's no `Webhook(s)` export. Mitigation: replaced with `Bell` (phosphor doesn't ship a webhook glyph; alternative: lucide-react has `Webhook`). (3) /app/frontend/src/pages/CoinDetail.jsx renders <LiveSwap/> but never imports it. Mitigation: added `import LiveSwap from '@/components/LiveSwap'`. All three crashed the page with a runtime ReferenceError visible in the dev overlay; would not have caught in a production build either since CRA dev compiles unused refs. Reproduction (pre-fix): visit /settings or /coins/bonk -> Uncaught runtime errors overlay. Post-fix: clean render.
